fatigue.text: Right now, the five hundred years of life experience was telling him, it was time to stop.
Heh, I am still a mortal, I am not an invincible god.
All the worries, all the pressure, all the impatience since the start till now dispersed with the wind.
After his rest was over, he activated the steel tendon Gu again without hesitation.

tier1_first_miss.text: Making mistakes was a normal thing, even rank nine venerables made many mistakes in their lives.
After making a mistake, realizing the mistake and correcting it was the behavior of an outstanding person!
Hardships and setbacks were the wealth of human life.

tier2_repeated_misses.text: Failure is fine, just try again several times. Even if I cannot achieve my goals in the end, so what?
I had once grieved, gradually, I became able to withstand everything.
The most important thing was an unyielding spirit, how could mere success and failure determine his life!

tier3_stuck.text: Heaven would never seal all of one's paths! There was no absolutely desperate situation in this world, there were only people who despair.
No matter what setbacks he faces, they would only be firewood that allows the demonic ambitions in his heart to burn even more brightly.
Even if he failed ten thousand times, a million times, or hundreds of billions of times, as long as there was a chance, Fang Yuan would never give up!

tier1_clean_solve.text: Fang Yuan did not become prideful due to victory, his joy lasted a very short moment before he dived into cultivating once again.
Such hard work caused Fang Yuan to improve rapidly. Almost every day, he made great progress.
I had once rejoiced, gradually, I became unmoved by the world.

tier2_sustained_run.text: Accumulating in secret, striking at once like a volcano, moving as fast as lightning, achieving one's goal!
All I have left is an expressionless face, my gaze is as tough as a monolith, only perseverance remains in my heart.
A heart of steel forged from countless setbacks, A lifetime of effort to forge one sword.

tier3_milestone.text: Because hardships strengthen resolve, the strong-minded will not be lured by worldly affairs. Today I step on grass; later I shall step on mountains and rivers!
Because it has no legs, only wings, thus it has no choice but to fly. When it lands, that signifies its destruction.
At times, your former achievements would be the greatest obstacle for you to achieve greater success!

same_day.text: After his rest was over, he activated the steel tendon Gu again without hesitation.
I am a person with a firm will, I do not hesitate, once I decide on a plan, I will execute it without doubt.
Rather than leaving these issues to the future, he should start resolving them now!

new_day.text: Let blood boil, let sweat flow, the best moment of life is now…
But these difficulties are only difficulties, if we are afraid to take action because of difficulties, nothing can be accomplished.
Farmers need to farm, but if they don't cultivate the land because they are afraid of drought, there would not even be a single grain of harvest.

gaps.text: What truly stalls a person's success is not talent, but mindset.
After all, an unknown enemy was the most troublesome. Know yourself and your enemy, and you will never be defeated!
I am crazy, I am an idiot, I am stubborn and also stupid. But I… still want to do it regardless!
I will never resign myself to fate! Even if I understand there is a wall called fate in front of me, I will charge into it!
